name: nasr
description: nasr (نثر): natural Persian prose and correct RTL documents. A writing workflow (concept → style cards → samples → final text) with styles measured on real Persian columnists and Iranian annual reports, plus register-aware prose, orthography, cleanup/spell-check scripts, RTL fixes for Word/PDF/PowerPoint/HTML/Excel/images, and bundled Vazirmatn/Lalezar fonts.
